heading: Today
text: Partly sunny north, and sun mixing with clouds south. A chance of a few showers through the St. Lawrence Valley, mostly late in the day. Highs in the upper 50s to low 60s, mid 60s in the Champlain and southern valleys. Winds light, becoming south near 10 mph east, 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph from the Green Mountains west.

heading: Tonight
text: Periods of clouds north, with a chance of an evening shower through Quebec, then a few scattered showers south to the Adirondacks and Rt. 2. Partly cloudy south. Not as cool. Lows in the 40s. Winds southwest near 10 mph east of the Green Mountains, light in sheltered valleys, and 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph west.

heading: Thursday
text: A mix of sun and clouds south. Periods of clouds north, with a good chance of showers through Quebec, scattered south through the Adirondacks and to Rt. 2. Highs 60 to 65. South winds, shifting to the west 10 to 15 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph.
